name: Niji no Kanata ni
source:
Protagonist's school is going to undergo renovation. In order not to lose school festival that falls on renovation time, it's decided to hold festival before renovation starts. Many of protagonist's acquaintances are chosen as executive committee members.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-february-2003-routes.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公所在的学校即将翻修。为了不失去恰好落在翻修期间的学园祭，众人决定在工程开始前举行庆典。主人公的许多熟人被选为执行委员。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-february-2003-routes.html]vndbreview[/url]]
